summary: Texxon Holding Ltd, a Cayman Islands exempted company trading on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K with its press release announcing unaudited financial results for the six months ended December 31, 2025 (first half of fiscal year 2026). The filing reports revenue of $327.0 million, gross profit of $1.2 million, a net loss of $1.0 million, and discusses a challenging chemical market, higher crude oil costs, competitive pricing, and the commencement of production at the Henan Polystyrene Factory. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event.
